title: Observability protocol translator for unified inference KPIs
creator: Maria Reyes
description: Problem: Inference telemetry currently flows through two partially incompatible paths: Prometheus scrapes (service metrics) and OTLP/OTel exports (runtime traces and custom KPIs). Teams building latency and error dashboards must stitch signals manually; model-level cardinality and label explosion causes storage and SLO calculation problems. This ticket implements a protocol translator component that normalizes Prometheus and OTLP inputs into a single, schema-first 'inference KPI envelope' and exposes a Prometheus-compatible scrape endpoint plus OTLP forwarder for downstream systems. The translator will perform label canonicalization, deterministic sampling knobs, canonical trace linking (attach trace_id/span_id to metric envelopes), and lightweight cardinality folding rules for model-route combinations. Goal: provide a stable, low-cardinality, high-fidelity stream of per-request inference KPIs (latency p50/p95/p99, error counters, model variant, route, customer_tier) consumable by dashboards and SLOs without changing all instrumented services at once.
acceptance_criteria: Translator accepts OTLP and Prometheus inputs and emits normalized envelopes to internal Kafka topic: inference-metrics-envelopes
Exposed Prometheus scrape replicates key KPI metrics with <=5% delta vs. canonical batch job for 99th percentile latency tests
Trace linking: 95% of metric envelopes include trace_id when upstream trace present
Cardinality reduction policy reduces unique model+route label combinations by >=60% for synthetic high-cardinality test while preserving top-10 model accuracy
No impact on existing dashboards or SLOs during canary: automatic fallback to raw paths if translator flag disabled
implementation_notes: Component will be deployed as a horizontally-scalable service in telemetry namespace behind a feature-flagged ingress
Input adapters: OTLP/gRPC receiver (use existing OTLP lib) + Prometheus remote write adapter (for scraped gauges/counters)
Normalization library will implement envelope schema v1.0 (fields: ts, tenant_id, route, model, model_variant, seq_len, latency_ms_p50/p95/p99, tokens_in/out, error_code, trace_id)
Cardinality folding uses deterministic hashing with configurable bucket size per tenant; policy table stored in configmap and updated via controllers
Sampling: implement deterministic reservoir by tenant+route and adaptive TTL for exemplars; avoid non-deterministic random sampling to keep reproducibility
Metrics for translator health: processed_count, dropped_count_by_reason, avg_processing_latency_ms, queue_depth
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): deploy translator in telemetry namespace, route 1% of OTLP traffic for a subset of non-critical tenants; validate envelope schema and backwards compatibility
Phase 2 (expand): increase traffic to 25% and enable Prometheus remote write passthrough for experimental routes; monitor dropped_count and queue latency
Phase 3 (rollback-safe switch): flip feature flag for select product dashboards to read envelopes topic; keep Prometheus scrape endpoints mirror until 2 weeks of stable metrics
Phase 4 (global): after validation, promote translator as primary path and deprecate legacy bridge with migration scripts and runbook
